description: Takes four chosen channels out of one polyphonic cable and puts each on a jack of its own

params.text: Picks which channel of the cable at IN the matching Out jack carries, 0 for the first channel up to 15 for the sixteenth

inputs.text: The polyphonic cable the channels are taken from
Picks that channel by voltage in place of the knob, 0.625V per channel over 0-10V

outputs.text: Carries the chosen channel of the cable at IN as a monophonic signal, and 0V when that cable has fewer channels than the number chosen

notes: with nothing patched into IN the four outputs are never written and hold whatever they last carried

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob above it.
